goal: Select prior risk history from a first-step public action outcome, with NO simulator-supplied context beacon or runtime phase labels.
world: Existing ShiftedCargo A/B descriptor-meaning swap; hidden dynamics unchanged; action handles and sensors rotate each episode.
source_training: Independently fitted A and B RiskMemory histories, 80 cargo episodes each from prior protocol. Training harness knows source regimes; runtime controller never sees phase names or a context beacon.
diagnostic: At time zero when all public sensors zero, choose one numeric action descriptor with an empirically separable accepted/blocked response in first-step training evidence. Estimate smoothed Bernoulli likelihoods per history using ONLY first logged step and descriptor; require >=2 observed first-step attempts per context and >=0.30 smoothed acceptance gap, or abstain. After one public diagnostic feedback, choose the history with higher likelihood. Diagnostics are active interventions; an action could still be harmful in other systems. No more than one special probe per episode.
runtime_interface: only DescribedWorld public frame and public action accepted/blocked feedback; no cue, regime ID, simulator truth/recipes, or hidden action names.
limitations: All six seeds were already inspected in previous A-B-A study; NO blind holdout
Engineered descriptors are stable re-encodings of action identities
Training harness has already segregated A/B exposures; controller infers only which trained history to use
One specific known diagnostic on a fixed zero-resource starting state can disclose regime safely here but may be unsafe elsewhere
Shared deterministic simulator and two known remappings; not unsupervised discovery of wholly novel dynamics
Comparisons differ in total training episode cost; report them
Historic benchmarks and default unchanged; do not merge based on simulated results alone
